# AZ Charter Schools Association

> The AZ Charter Schools Association advocates for and supports Arizona's public charter school sector through membership, professional development, business solutions, and research.

Founded in 1995, the Association serves as the primary resource hub for Arizona charter school operators, leaders, and stakeholders. It provides membership benefits, professional learning opportunities, vendor marketplace access, and comprehensive school quality data through its Education Evaluator tool.

## Key Topics

- Arizona Education

## Organization Overview

- [Home](https://azcharters.org): Homepage introducing AZ Charter Schools Association mission and membership opportunities.
- [About the Association](https://azcharters.org/about): Organization overview of AZ Charter Schools Association founded in 1995.
- [About Charter Schools](https://azcharters.org/about-charters): Educational information about Arizona's public charter school sector.
- [Staff and Board](https://azcharters.org/about/staff-and-board): Leadership directory of Association staff and board of directors.
- [Contact Information](https://azcharters.org/about/contact): Contact information and office details for AZ Charter Schools Association.

## Membership & Services

- [Membership](https://azcharters.org/membership): School and corporate membership options with Charter Smarter online resources.
- [IMPACT Business Solutions](https://azcharters.org/impact): IMPACT Business Solutions offering financial and compliance services for schools.
- [Charter Marketplace Directory](https://azcharters.org/find-vendor): Searchable vendor directory with exclusive pricing for Arizona charter schools.

## School Resources & Support

- [Resources Hub](https://azcharters.org/resources): Central hub for school development, support, and research resources.
- [New School Development](https://azcharters.org/resources/new-school-development): Guidance and membership for new Arizona charter school operators.
- [Support for School Leaders](https://azcharters.org/resources/school-support): Professional development and support resources for charter school leaders.
- [Quality Standards](https://azcharters.org/resources/quality-standards): Quality Standards Evaluation Tool framework for charter school excellence.
- [Research and Data](https://azcharters.org/resources/research): Research analyses and educational data on Arizona school quality.

## Learning & Networking

- [Learning & Networking Events](https://azcharters.org/events): Professional learning and networking events for charter school stakeholders.
- [Signature Events](https://azcharters.org/events/signature-events): Members-only signature events and professional development opportunities.
- [Speaker Series & Professional Learning](https://azcharters.org/events/speaker-series): Customized trainings and speaker series for charter school leaders and staff.

## Tools & Research

- [The Education Evaluator: Arizona's Public School Search Tool](https://azcharters.org/the-education-evaluator-school-search-tool): Public school search tool comparing Arizona district and charter schools.

## Optional

- [Association Publications](https://azcharters.org/impact/newsroom): Newsroom and publications hub with media inquiries and recent posts.
